summary.title: FlyBook STRIDE Threat Model
summary.description: FlyBook is a local Docker-based web application where users can search for flights and make bookings. The system consists of a PHP 7.3 and Apache web container and a MySQL 8.0 database container. The user accesses the web application through a browser on localhost:8000. The web container communicates with the database container to store and retrieve application data. The database is exposed locally on localhost:3307 and uses MySQL internally on port 3306.
